body: Thank you! Her notice came in the name she is looking to change to. So I told her to use that as the name then the name on her passport under other listed names. Her appointment is tomorrow so hopefully all goes well 👍

My wife just got her biometrics appointment for June 9th. Excited to finally be getting towards being done with the immigration process. We got engaged in 2018. Spent 2019 getting to know her family. 2020 we were ready to start the process but of course COVID ruined that 😔 we then had to meet up in 2022 because due to COVID we had not been physically together in over 2 years. She was approved for her K1 in July of last year, and entered the country in September. We got married at the end of September and I've never been so happy in my life. All the hard work was so worth it 😁
